digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime auth injection through ProviderSession
propositions: Add typed provider-specific LLMRuntime auth/session capabilities in src/rebar/llm/auth.py that remain non-serializable and outside config/cache/schema/output boundaries.
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept and pass LLMRuntime into the single per-run ProviderSession builder without forking the RP-01 authorization/policy path.
Ensure exactly one Rebar-owned official client is constructed/closed and provider-native precedence/refresh/expiry are retained by the SDK without raw token extraction outside the provider builder.
Fail before a provider model request if explicit auth is missing or conflicting, with no fallback to anonymous/alternate-principal/cross-provider providers.
Preserve all RP-01 semantics: output policy, request budget, cache accounting, typed exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage normalization, and failure handling unchanged.
Provider-native capability reaches only the existing ProviderSession builder; no second runner/client owner, Agent construction route, or bespoke retry scheduler is permitted.
